title: When Can Learned Uncertainty Be Trusted? An Audit of Distributional Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.11607v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many learned predictive models represent their uncertainty as a probability distribution, and planners and policies use this distribution to judge risk. However, the fact that a model outputs a distribution does not tell us whether that distribution captures the uncertainty in the environment which is relevant for a decision. In this work we study this question in distributional reinforcement learning, where the learned return distribution P_{\theta}(Z | s,a) can be compared directly with an environment-grounded distribution P_env(Z | s,a) estimated by snapshot-restart Monte Carlo. Our audit first screens for the claims that a risk-sensitive user would act upon, using the excess Wasserstein gap between the top two actions (which is equal to the mass by which first-order stochastic dominance is violated). translated_title: 什么时候可以信任学习到的不确定性？对分布式强化学习的审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.11607v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：许多学习到的预测模型将其不确定性表示为概率分布，规划者和策略利用这个分布来判断风险。然而，模型输出分布这一事实并不能告诉我们该分布是否捕捉到了环境中与决策相关的不确定性。在这项工作中，我们在分布式强化学习中研究这个问题，其中学习到的回报分布 P_{\theta}(Z | s,a) 可以与通过快照重启蒙特卡洛估计的基于环境的分布 P_env(Z | s,a) 直接比较。我们的审计首先筛选风险敏感用户会据此采取行动的声明，使用前两个动作之间的超额 Wasserstein 间隙（它等于一阶随机占优被违反的量）。然后使用置换零假设、自助法反驳和 FDR 控制对每个声明进行真值检验。在 QR-DQN、C51...
tldr: 该论文提出了一套针对分布式强化学习回报分布的审计框架，通过超额 Wasserstein 间隙筛选风险敏感决策声明，并利用置换检验、自助法反驳和 FDR 控制来验证学习到的不确定性分布是否真实捕捉了环境中的不确定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an audit framework for return distributions in distributional reinforcement learning, which screens risk-sensitive decision claims using the excess Wasserstein gap between top actions and validates them against ground truth via permutation nulls, bootstrap refutation, and FDR control, to determine when learned uncertainty distributions can be trusted.
